correctness.rationale: All 1024 Petersen states are covered by 34 explicitly checked S5 orbits, with exact degree-three update; T6=T4 but T5!=T3. Complete 124-symbol, 14/55, and 1/10/226 fiber tables verified by independent exact operations. Checked explicit graph isomorphism connects Petersen bipartite double to GP(10,3). Swap conjugacy and fibers yield 124 fixed, 7626 two-cycles, nine basin classes; independent complete C++ 1048576-state functional-graph census verifies the sharp entry four and the ten entrance populations. Both verification programs and outputs embedded in this finding.

value.rationale: Natural full classification for two canonical cubic symmetric graphs; the 34 graph-isomorphism classes on five vertices provide a compact exact certificate. The 124 recurrent shore symbols and three fiber weights explain both the lifted abundance of 7626 oscillations and the unique large basin. These precise invariants are not routine deductions of the generic period-two theorem and give a useful finite benchmark; no broader theorem is claimed.
